caveats: ReadMe (קובץ מעבר מקלפיות אוקטובר 2026): the file was prepared in July 2026; the CEC balances stations after that (איזון קלפיות), which changes their composition and numbers, so the station data in the CEC results file cannot be fully linked to this file.

The file covers only 64 of the 128 Arab localities (27.1% of their K25 eligible voters) and 12 of the 18 Druze localities; all nine mixed cities and almost every Jewish locality are in it. A locality missing from the file has not been abolished.
Station numbers are CBS integers (no sub-stations). A CEC base number X (X, X.1, X.2 ...) is CBS station X; the CBS stations the CEC merged into a group are not identifiable from the numbers.

Stable (ReadMe, Stable_kalpi_october_2026): not a collecting station, not in a non-locality (tribe, army camp), and no new boundary, merge or split, voter move or locality change from 7.7.2022 to 30.5.2026. Used as a flag only; 39 localities of its count sheet (41 stations, new settlements among them) are not on its list.
census: the modal religion of the 2022 unit only (the census publishes no shares; small areas are merged units such as 122+121).

analog.rule: truth = the new election's own Arab-list share >= .5 per CEC group (code, base number); eligible-weighted over the ten mixed_arab codes; K25-K24 and K25-K23 run backwards (base fixed at 2022, as the live code reads 2026 against 2022)

format: stations: {code: {n, stable, areas?, nums?}}, numbers as runs (an int or [first, last]); areas only where a locality has more than one 2022 area (otherwise area 1); nums only where the numbers are not 1..n. mixed: {code: {number: {a22, stable, k25, share, census}}}, census = the census modal religion (ReligionHeb: jews יהודים, muslims מוסלמים, christians נוצרים, druze דרוזים, other דת אחרת)
